analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited reported strong growth in Q1 FY27, driven by the expansion of its offline business and the development of its digital platform, AkikoPay. The company revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to INR 325-350 crores and expects a PAT margin of 9% to 11% for the year. Management plans to expand its branch network and expects loan disbursements to reach INR 1,000 crores by December end. While the Dubai business faced temporary pressure due to geopolitical issues, it has started to revive. Akiko Global Services Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, highlighting robust revenue growth and disciplined profitability across its core credit card sourcing and lending businesses.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY27 revenue guidance to INR 325 crores to INR 350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects its CAGR to remain at 70% to 100% year-on-year for the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company aims to reach around INR 1,000 crores in disbursements by December end.
guidance.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

guidance.claim: Management expects AkikoPay to achieve its target of around INR 50 crores of revenue by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: I can see that we would be able to achieve this particular number you are saying by FY27 end.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently growing the fastest among the company's loan products.
The company's offline business, core business, and distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.
demand_outlook.quote: Unlike other fintechs that burn money in their initial years, we are not focusing on losing money at all because our offline business, our core business, and our distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing good interaction in the use cases of payments and credit products.
demand_outlook.quote: In the use case of payments, we are seeing good interaction. And in the use case of credit products, I am seeing good interaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Credit card penetration remains relatively low at approximately 7-8% of the population, providing significant expansion potential.
demand_outlook.quote: Credit card penetration remains relatively low at ~7-8% of the population, indicating significant headroom for expansion compared to global benchmarks.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently added branches in Kolkata, UP, and Hyderabad.
capex_expansion.quote: This year we recently added a Kolkata branch, two branches in UP, one more branch in Hyderabad, and currently these are the ones.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open branches in Indore and Kerala over the next two to three months.
capex_expansion.quote: Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has a plan for 25 branches in total.
capex_expansion.quote: There is a plan for 25 branches in total.

capex_expansion.claim: All of the company's branches are rented or leased rather than owned.
capex_expansion.quote: All are on rent/lease. None are owned.

margins_costs.claim: Management is confident of achieving a 9% to 11% PAT margin for this year.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

margins_costs.claim: The PAT margin could increase to 12% to 14% next year if AkikoPay performs well.
margins_costs.quote: If AkikoPay works very well, next year that will go up to 12% to 14%.

margins_costs.claim: The company will acquire customers at a negligible cost using only employees and the existing database.
margins_costs.quote: We will acquire customers at a negligible cost using only our employees and existing database.

margins_costs.claim: The company's profit faced slight stress last quarter because they opened several branches across multiple cities.
margins_costs.quote: As I mentioned last time, our profit faced slight stress last quarter because we opened several branches across multiple cities.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay achieved approximately 40% lower customer acquisition costs compared to traditional channels.
margins_costs.quote: ~40% lower CAC vs traditional channels, enabled by a lean, digital-first model

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a database of 25 million.
orders_capacity.quote: But for that, we have thought that with the kind of data we have -- we have a database of 25 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's team includes 16 people on tech, around 700 on sales, and around 50 on the backend.
orders_capacity.quote: Look, currently on the tech side, we have a total of 16 people -- 16 people on the tech side. On the sales side, we have odd 700 people. On the backend side, we have odd 50 people. And the rest are our management staff.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals increased to over ₹450 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000 to 18,000 cards.
orders_capacity.quote: monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

capital_allocation.claim: The company does not plan to raise any funds for the next 6 months to a year.
capital_allocation.quote: So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

capital_allocation.claim: Receivable days have decreased to 110 days and are expected to fall below 90 days in Q2.
capital_allocation.quote: From 133 days, receivable days are coming down to 110 days. In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's Dubai business generated INR 1.25 crores in revenue for the quarter due to war.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

management_commitments.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

management_commitments.quote: As for what we planned for AkikoPay, over the next 2 years, I will compete with the major leaders in the market.
